g.text: Local recovery separates a sensor failure from a geometry-method motivation

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #244a67

g.text: Same fitted asset → fixed 10-sweep scan → one local field intervention → same frozen CenterPoint
Hatched bars: score ≥ 0.3 Solid bars: score ≥ 0.5 All matches require correct class and BEV IoU ≥ 0.5.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #244a67

g.text: Local real replacement: 8/8 for both readouts. Median + intensity alone: 7/8 at score0.5; position-only: 2/8 raw, 3/8 median.
GT box + 0.25m neighborhood; evaluator-held real scans are extra information. Position-only snaps predicted points to same-time real neighbors;
intensity-only keeps positions/counts fixed. These are sensor interventions, not edits to the reconstruction asset. No planning/safety recovery was measured.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #244a67

g.text: Decision: retain the observed perception loss; do not promote this case as a pure geometry or phantom-surface Hero motivation.
